title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Duty Recorder. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Duty Recorder
options.lineage: Sangamo and Kienzle tachograph chart discs, reefer temperature recorders, mechanical hour meters
options.thesis: The 24-hour duty day is a machined instrument record: the trip revolves once on a printed chart disc and the pen draws what the driver will sign.
options.viewport: One anodised instrument chassis fills the frame: knurled winder, glass-lensed 24-hour disc turning under a pen, and a real three-field route plate engraved into the faceplate that plans the trip in place.
options.risk: Reads as a prop unless the disc is driven by the user's own trip data.

raised.raise: Charged emptiness — the faceplate keeps halved silence around the disc instead of filling every quadrant.
Rule by demonstration — each § 395 limit is plotted as an event on the disc, never described in a paragraph.
Lit or unlit — duty states print as solid ink or nothing; no midtone hedge.

options.label: The Log Grid
options.lineage: FMCSA MCS-59 daily log graph paper
options.thesis: The 24-hour ruled grid becomes the page's whole architecture, printed at architectural scale.
options.viewport: A full-bleed oversized graph row where one hour is a hand's width; the trip's first day draws itself in ink across it.
options.risk: Also the direction most runs in this category land on.

options.label: Segment Mask
options.lineage: seven-segment displays: bedside clocks, price totems, scoreboards
options.thesis: Eight cells make every glyph, and unlit segments are drawn as deliberately as lit ones.
options.viewport: One rigid eight-cell mask fills the viewport; the trip's duty states light in fixed slots as the calculation runs.
options.case: Fuses cleanly — off-duty is real data, so absence becomes design — but loses on depth for a whole page.
options.risk: A single display family is thin as a page's world.

options.label: Course Over Terrain
options.lineage: ISOM orienteering maps and control descriptions
options.thesis: Terrain is a fixed colour language and the route rides above it in one reserved purple.
options.viewport: A fixed-scale terrain legend fills the frame with the numbered trip course laid over it and a coded description row per control.
options.case: Fuses cleanly — every rest and fuel stop becomes a control with a coded row — but loses on audience identification.
options.risk: Reads as a map product rather than a compliance instrument.

options.label: Custody Ribbon
options.thesis: The day's hours are a custody chain: one continuous ribbon of possession through the trip.
options.viewport: A single dated ribbon threads the whole first viewport, folding at every duty transition the trip produces.
options.case: Fuses cleanly — the duty line genuinely is a custody line — but loses narrowly on audience identification.
options.risk: Reads archival when the ribbon stops moving.

options.label: Ikebana Ma
options.thesis: Line and asymmetry make the surrounding emptiness the most active element.
options.case: Fuses poorly: dispatchers do not identify with a flower alcove, and precision suffers.
options.kept: Charged emptiness around the active element.

options.label: Marker Zine
options.thesis: A marker sketch on a napkin teaches a hard rule better than a spec sheet.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a friendly napkin hero undercuts a precision compliance tool.
options.kept: Teaching a rule by plotting the actual event instead of describing it.

options.label: Two-State Bill
options.thesis: Acid yellow and black with no midtone: everything resolves to lit or unlit at a hard edge.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the programme-of-acts topology does not map to a trip.
options.kept: No midtone: every state resolves to lit or unlit with a hard edge.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What dispatching software ships, executed impeccably: dark console, map beside a form, log sheet preview below.
canonCard.viewport: The arrangement a visitor expects, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
